decisions.why: Drape kits and cardiac loop/extremity/hand procedure packs are clinical procedure packs.
Thyroid, laparotomy and laparoscopy drape packs are general theatre consumables.
BIS/Entropy sensors and temperature probes are monitoring sensors, while irrigation electrodes and instrument pads are general theatre consumables, so the division genuinely spans both.
Underbuttock drapes and reinforced/standard gowns are general theatre consumables.
